title: Little Birdwatcher
hook: One field mark starts the idea; several build the ID.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one clear observation beat before answer
visualStyle: friendly 3D birdwatching storybook, simple trail and binocular motifs, natural bright colors, isolated birds

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child making cautious multi-trait bird identifications
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written field marks with range/habitat; no nest disturbance
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: field-mark cue -> recall beat -> target -> point/sketch gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a pizzicato binocular-click followed by one clear bell note after the target.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a pizzicato binocular-click followed by one clear bell note after the target
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Little Birdwatcher a disciplined field-identification song: size, silhouette, bill, legs, flight, habitat and call combine before a name; distance and nest ethics are built in.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child birdwatcher records multiple field marks and leaves uncertain IDs open instead of answering every echo instantly.
